prompt: Which leap year happened exactly halfway between the birth of Shoghi Effendi and the founding of the college he attended?
answer:
The leap year was **1580**.

Shoghi Effendi was born in **1897**, and Balliol College— which he attended—was founded in **1263**. The midpoint between 1263 and 1897 is **1580**, a leap year.
